_comment: Self-fix allowlist for the numbers-truth audit (DSN-20261109 REV 2 section D, REV 3 section G). Changed only by reviewed PR.

A heal is ONE run request of the PRODUCER lane through the sanctioned host path (scripts/lib/n8n_cc_wave_c.enqueue_host_run -> n8n_coordination_gateway.host_run_request), rate-limited to one per lane per hour, recorded in the audit receipt.

It is never a broker write, an order, a DB write, a code edit, a cron edit or a systemd edit. Authority findings (REV 3 G) never heal: a source change is operator-only (AGENTS.md section 17), so they ticket at strike 3.
Only ACTIVE n8n lanes are healable (REV 2 D). The KEEP_ON_CRON producers are not: strike 3 for their figures tickets directly.

page_codes is the ONLY list that reaches the D34 critical page (Telegram + email + Fi text). Every other code is a strike/ticket/FINDING file only: no Telegram, no text, no email. Operator 2026-11-09 19:00 ET (LQ-20261107-1726).

known_disagreement lists measured FAILs the operator has accepted as known source disagreements. Each entry needs check, reason, approved_by and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, default 30 days); symbol/account narrow it (absent = any). An entry suppresses its own strike, never a heal/clear/page/pass, and an expired entry changes nothing. The list ships EMPTY; entries are operator-approved (AGENTS.md section 17).

vix-index-quotes-schwab.why: re-reads the VIX/index quotes and reports the tiles' source; ACTIVE n8n lane with a dry_run arg only

cio-overnight-brief.why: rebuilds the brief the CIO 'now' prices and session-day prose come from; ACTIVE n8n lane

holdings-drift-monitor.why: re-measures holdings vs positions_current and writes its own receipt; ACTIVE n8n lane, read-only against the stores

held-exit-coverage-monitor.why: re-measures held-position stop coverage; ACTIVE n8n lane, read-only against the stores

not_healable.positions-sync: KEEP_ON_CRON producer; a heal here would be a data write outside the operator's schedule
not_healable.schwab-position-sync: KEEP_ON_CRON producer; broker-adjacent, never run off-slot
not_healable.stop-health-check: KEEP_ON_CRON producer; stop reads on its own schedule
not_healable.market-quotes-*: KEEP_ON_CRON producers (one per provider); never run off-slot

escalation.channels_note: A NEW ticket pages immediately through the D34 critical-alert hub (scripts/lib/critical_channels.deliver, class numbers_truth_ticket): Critical Telegram chat + email + every Google Fi email-to-text line, never quiet-held (REV 3 H). The intent queued below is the durable incident record; its P2 copy also reaches email via config/comms_email_mirror.json. A cleared line is an intent only: Telegram + email, never a text.
